name: planted-v1b
purpose: Questions answerable only by experiment: each is a generated process with a planted effect, none, or one below the threshold. Held out: prompts must never be tuned against these items.

items.question: In the lab datasets whose names start with q01_ (independent samples of one process) (a binary label and features x1-x6, g1-g3), does adding the features g1, g2 and g3 to x1-x6 raise the held-out accuracy of a logistic regression by at least 1 percentage point(s)?

reference.conclusion: Yes. By construction the effect is +0.01745 against a threshold of 0.01.
reference.source: planted: generated data, truth computed on 200,000 rows
